74: // setNilHardforkTimestampsToDefault overwrites each unspecified hardfork activation time override
75: // with the superchain default.
76: func (c *ChainConfig) setNilHardforkTimestampsToDefault(s *SuperchainConfig) {
77: 	overrides := reflect.ValueOf(&c.HardForkConfiguration).Elem()
78: 	defaults := reflect.ValueOf(&s.hardForkDefaults).Elem()
79: 
80: 	for i := 0; i < overrides.NumField(); i++ {
81: 		overrideValue := overrides.Field(i)
82: 		if overrideValue.IsNil() {
83: 			overrideValue.Set(defaults.Field(i))
84: 		}
85: 	}
86:
